verdict.rationale: Rippling documents narrow built-in AI features—natural-language report/dashboard building ('Show me headcount vs plan'), AI-driven benefits document review, and an AI assistant for employee benefits questions—showing some task delegation to an embedded assistant, but not a general-purpose AI assistant users can delegate arbitrary tasks to across the platform. Missing for 10: a unified, cross-module AI assistant, independent/hands-on verification of these AI features actually working, and evidence of open-ended task delegation beyond specific reporting/benefits use cases.
